lines.text: MCP doesn't say who's calling. We do.
Every tool call your agent makes carries a signed envelope.
Inside: the principal — a real human. The agent — and exactly what it may do. An approval chain. And an expiry.
The envelope rides the call itself — in the MCP underscore-meta slot. The call and the identity travel together. No side channel. No trust-me.
The server verifies the signature, checks the expiry, enforces the scope — per user, per call. Every call, every time — not once at login.
And afterward, the audit trail answers: eight events, acted on behalf of alice. Not "the agent did it." Alice did it.
